rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA label, but it overstates image-confirmable detail (e.g., exact ICM position, cell counts, tight junctions, 2x diameter) and infers features not reliably visible from a single embryo image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, first cycle status, and day-5 3AA quality into prognosis well, though it makes some unsupported assumptions such as likely multiple blastocysts and implied ICSI.

Overall logical and well-structured, with a plausible prognosis and management plan, but some quantitative claims are overconfident and a few links between morphology and euploidy are stronger than evidence supports.

Core recommendations like eSET for a good-prognosis 34-year-old and attention to transfer technique/luteal support are guideline-concordant, but suggestions such as aspirin, thrombophilia/MTHFR workup, endometrial scratch, and ERA after limited failure are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer strategy, endometrial checks, luteal support, and contingency planning, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
